title: Follow community rating in private health insurance
what: A private health insurer must not take action, or have regard to matters, that would improperly discriminate between people who are or wish to be insured.

sources.title: Private Health Insurance Act 2007
sources.quote: 55-5 Principle of community rating (1) A private health insurer must not: (a) take or fail to take any action; or (b) in making a decision, have regard or fail to have regard to any matter; that would result in the insurer *improperly discriminating between people who are or wish to be insured under a *complying health insurance policy of the insurer.

administration.who: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
